title: Grateful Dead Live at Kezar Stadium on 1973-05-26

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix capture of a high‑energy classic show, highlighted by Bill's wild drumming from the opening note.
ai_review.review: The new matrix blend is praised as crystal‑clear and immersive, delivering what reviewers call “perfect sound” for an already top‑drawer performance. Bill Kreutzmann’s relentless, crazy drumming sets a nonstop high‑energy tone that never lets up. No specific song moments are called out, but the overall vibe is overwhelmingly positive.

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic reviews (two 5‑star) highlight superb matrix sound quality and a high‑energy show, giving strong evidence for a high rating despite limited detail on setlist specifics.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the matrix as “amazing sounding”, “perfect sound”, and a brand‑new quality soundscape, indicating a clear, well‑balanced blend of board and audience sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Opening with Bill’s frantic drumming and maintaining relentless momentum throughout; the show is characterized as nonstop high energy.

band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming is highlighted as “going crazy” and driving the show from start to finish.
